questions.q_en:
In the following question, the statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusions is/are true?

Statement: H > Y ≥ W < J = Z > V ≥ G

Conclusions:

I. H > Z

II. J ≥ G
options_en: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
Both conclusions I and II are true
questions.solution_en:
Given statement is H > Y ≥ W < J = Z > V ≥ G

H > Y ≥ W < J = Z

So, conclusion I is false.

J = Z > V ≥ G

So, conclusion II is false.

Thus, Neither conclusion I nor II is true.

questions.q_en: The thickness of five different types of liquids L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5 are compared. L3 is thinner than L4. L5 is not thicker than L3. L1 is thicker than L4. More than three liquids are thicker than L2. How many liquids are thicker than L5?
questions.solution_en:
The thickness of five different types of liquids L1, L2, L3, L4 and L5 are compared.

More than three liquids are thicker than L2.

___ > ___> ___> ___> L2.

L3 is thinner than L4. L5 is not thicker than L3. L1 is thicker than L4.

So, L1 > L4 > L3 > L5.

Thus, L1 > L4 > L3 > L5 > L2.

So, three liquids are thicker than L5.

questions.q_en: In a row of 'X' students, all are facing in the same direction. Payal is 37th from the left end of a row. Five persons are there towards the right of Jack, who is third to the left of Payal. Then what will be the value of 'X'?
questions.solution_en:
In a row of 'X' students, all are facing in the same direction.

Payal is 37th from the left end of a row.

36 personsPayal 37th from left end

Five persons are there towards the right of Jack, who is third to the left of Payal.

33 personsJack2 personsPayal 37th from left end2 persons

Then the value of 'X' = 33 + Jack + 2 + Payal + 2 = 39 persons.

questions.q_en:
Find the missing term (?) in the following series.

512, 64, 192, 24, 72, ?
questions.solution_en:
Logic for the given series -

512 ÷ 8 = 64

64 X 3 = 192

192 ÷ 8 = 24

24 X 3 = 72

72 ÷ 8 = 9

Hence, missing term = 9
